detailed_descriptions.en: Where It All Began Before smartphones. Before app stores. ZENONIA set the foundation for mobile RPGs. Now, this iconic action RPG returns in its original form—refined for modern platforms. A Classic, Reimagined Bringing back the original charm while adapting seamlessly to today’s platforms. Whether you're here for nostalgia or a brand-new adventure— ZENONIA is ready. Classic RPG, Timeless Depth Choose your path from three distinct classes: Warrior – Balanced and resilient Paladin – Defensive and reliable Assassin – Fast and lethal Customize your stats and gear to build a playstyle that’s truly yours. A Journey Driven by Choice In a world where light and darkness collide, every decision matters. Unfold a rich story filled with unexpected events, and shape your path between good and evil. Endless Progression - Hundreds of items across multiple tiers - Deep systems combining skills, gear, and character growth There is always more to discover.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Where It All Began

Before smartphones. Before app stores.

ZENONIA set the foundation for mobile RPGs.

Now, this iconic action RPG returns in its original form—refined for modern platforms.

A Classic, Reimagined

Bringing back the original charm

while adapting seamlessly to today’s platforms.

Whether you're here for nostalgia

or a brand-new adventure—

ZENONIA is ready.

Classic RPG, Timeless Depth

Choose your path from three distinct classes:

Warrior – Balanced and resilient

Paladin – Defensive and reliable

Assassin – Fast and lethal

Customize your stats and gear

to build a playstyle that’s truly yours.

A Journey Driven by Choice

In a world where light and darkness collide,

every decision matters.

Unfold a rich story filled with unexpected events,

and shape your path between good and evil.

Endless Progression

- Hundreds of items across multiple tiers

- Deep systems combining skills, gear, and character growth

There is always more to discover.
